entities.summary: Kenneth Benard Gabriel is an American professional basketball player for CS Vâlcea 1924 of the Romanian Liga Națională. At a height of 6 ft 9 in (2.06 m) tall, he plays at the power forward position. He played college basketball for the Auburn Tigers.
